text: A man never cut his left-hand nails for sixty-six years.
Nails grow about three millimeters a month, and usually snap long before it matters.
Shridhar Chillal, India, started at fourteen, after a teacher scolded him for breaking hers.
By 2018: almost thirty feet. A world record.
He says the hand locked into a fist, and he woke every half hour to move it.
In July 2018, a saw in Times Square cut them off.
So yes, skip the clippers. Just know what it cost him.
